project.name: pawjai-backend
project.description: REST API for Pawjai — a pet management platform covering health records, AI chat, subscriptions, and push notifications. Built with Bun, Fastify 5, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Zod, and TypeScript 5.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Main server entry point that bootstraps Fastify with CORS, helmet, multipart, rate limiting, and raw body plugins, registers all API route prefixes (auth, pets, chat, subscriptions, admin, etc.), sets up health check endpoints, initializes startup services including migrations, and starts background cron jobs for notifications and chat cleanup.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Creates and exports the Drizzle ORM database instance connected to PostgreSQL via the DATABASE_URL environment variable, loading the full schema namespace for typed query building.

nodes.name: schema.ts
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for the entire PostgreSQL database schema using Drizzle ORM, defining 30+ tables (user profiles, pets, subscriptions, pet records, weight records, insights, notifications, reminders, chat messages, blog posts, admin platform, pricing config, onboarding analytics, helper/vet share tokens, external domains) along with their enums, indexes, foreign key relationships, and inferred TypeScript types.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of Drizzle ORM pgTable/pgEnum builders with computed TypeScript types via $inferSelect/$inferInsert for full type safety across the application.

nodes.name: stripe.ts
nodes.summary: Initializes and exports a singleton Stripe SDK client, requiring STRIPE_SECRET_KEY in non-development environments while allowing a missing key during development and test.

nodes.name: auth.ts
nodes.summary: Provides Fastify middleware for user authentication by verifying Supabase JWTs and attaching the authenticated user to the request object, with three modes: required (authenticateUser), factory (requireAuth), and optional (optionalAuth).

nodes.name: adminAuth.ts
nodes.summary: Provides admin authentication and authorization middleware that verifies admin JWT tokens, checks admin existence and active status in the database, loads permissions, and offers role-based and permission-based access control guards plus a token generation helper.

nodes.name: petAccess.ts
nodes.summary: Provides subscription-aware middleware that verifies whether a user can access a specific pet (requirePetAccess) or create additional pets (checkPetCreationLimit) based on their effective subscription plan, returning 403 with upgrade hints when limits are exceeded.

nodes.name: jwt.ts
nodes.summary: Handles Supabase JWT verification using the admin client for cryptographic validation, decodes and validates the payload shape with Zod, and provides helper functions to extract user identity and check token expiration.

nodes.name: logger.ts
nodes.summary: Lightweight structured logger with configurable log levels (silent/error/warn/info/debug) based on NODE_ENV and LOG_LEVEL environment variables, outputting timestamped and scope-prefixed messages to console.

nodes.name: cache.ts
nodes.summary: Provides a generic TTL-based in-memory cache (MemoryCache class) with automatic periodic cleanup of expired entries, plus a memoize utility that wraps async functions with transparent caching using configurable TTL and key generation.

nodes.name: authenticateUser
nodes.summary: Core authentication middleware that extracts the Bearer token from the Authorization header, verifies it as a Supabase JWT, and attaches the decoded user to the request, with detailed error handling for expired tokens and network failures.

nodes.name: optionalAuth
nodes.summary: Optional authentication middleware that silently skips auth when no token is present, allowing unauthenticated access while still enriching the request with user data when a valid token exists.

nodes.name: requireAdmin
nodes.summary: Verifies an admin JWT token, checks that the admin exists and is active in the database, loads their permissions from the admin_permissions table, and attaches the full admin context to the request.

nodes.name: requirePermission
nodes.summary: Factory that returns middleware checking if the authenticated admin has a specific permission, automatically granting all permissions to super_admin role.

nodes.name: requireRole
nodes.summary: Factory that returns middleware verifying the authenticated admin has a specific role, returning 403 when the role does not match.

nodes.name: generateAdminToken
nodes.summary: Generates a signed JWT token for an admin user with a 7-day expiration, encoding their ID, email, and role.

nodes.name: requirePetAccess
nodes.summary: Middleware that resolves the user's effective subscription plan, checks if the specified pet is accessible under that plan, and attaches plan/access metadata to the request or returns a 403 with upgrade hints.

nodes.name: checkPetCreationLimit
nodes.summary: Middleware that checks whether the user can create additional pets based on their subscription plan limits (1 for free, 10 for premium), returning 403 with pet count details when the limit is reached.

nodes.name: verifySupabaseJWT
nodes.summary: Verifies a Supabase JWT by calling the admin client's getUser endpoint for cryptographic validation, then decodes and validates the token's claims against a Zod schema.

nodes.name: extractUserFromJWT
nodes.summary: Extracts a minimal user object (id, email, role) from a validated Supabase JWT payload.

nodes.name: isTokenExpired
nodes.summary: Checks whether a JWT token has expired by decoding its exp claim without cryptographic verification.

nodes.name: MemoryCache
nodes.summary: Generic TTL-based in-memory cache backed by a Map, with automatic periodic cleanup of expired entries every 30 seconds and methods for get, set, delete, clear, size, and destroy.

nodes.name: memoize
nodes.summary: Higher-order function that wraps an async function with transparent MemoryCache-based caching, supporting configurable TTL and custom key generation.

nodes.name: api-response.ts
nodes.summary: Centralized API response factory providing typed interfaces (ApiResponse, PaginatedApiResponse, ErrorApiResponse) and helper functions for consistent HTTP response formatting across all routes, including success, error, paginated, and HTTP-status-specific responses.

nodes.name: auditLog.ts
nodes.summary: Provides admin audit logging functions that persist admin actions (single and batch) to the database via Drizzle ORM, with both async and fire-and-forget variants, plus a typed AUDIT_ACTIONS constant map.

nodes.name: logAdminAction
nodes.summary: Asynchronously inserts a single admin audit log entry into the database, catching and logging any errors.

nodes.name: logAdminActions
nodes.summary: Batch-inserts multiple admin audit log entries into the database in a single operation for efficiency.

nodes.name: date.ts
nodes.summary: Exports a single helper function that constructs an ISO date string from optional year/month/day components, returning undefined if any part is missing or invalid.

nodes.name: format.ts
nodes.summary: Provides a weight formatting function that converts kilograms to the user's preferred unit (kg or lb) for display in AI-generated content.

nodes.name: locale.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves the user's preferred language from query parameters, Accept-Language header, or defaults to English, used for localized API responses.

nodes.name: pagination.ts
nodes.summary: Defines pagination interfaces (PaginationOptions, PaginatedResponse) and provides helper functions for validating, calculating, and constructing paginated responses used across all list endpoints.

nodes.name: calculatePaginationInfo
nodes.summary: Calculates pagination metadata (total pages, hasNext, hasPrev) from total count, current page, and page size.

nodes.name: rateLimiter.ts
nodes.summary: Factory function that creates an in-memory IP-based rate limiter as a Fastify preHandler, with configurable max requests per window and periodic cleanup of expired entries.

nodes.name: bunny.ts
nodes.summary: BunnyService class encapsulating all Bunny.net CDN storage operations including image upload (with sharp-based resizing to WebP for profiles), deletion, and URL generation for user profiles, pet profiles, chat images, and blog content.

nodes.name: BunnyService
nodes.summary: CDN storage service with context-aware upload methods that process images (512x512 WebP for profiles) and manage file storage on Bunny.net, exported as a singleton instance.

nodes.name: pet-profile.util.ts
nodes.summary: Fetches and assembles a complete pet profile by joining pet, breed, weight history, activity records, and user subscription data from the database into a unified PetProfile interface for use by AI chat and health insights.

nodes.name: weight-validation.util.ts
nodes.summary: Breed-aware pet weight validation with anomaly detection that uses breed knowledge data and species/size fallbacks to flag outlier weights, accounting for young pets not yet fully grown, returning bilingual warning messages.

nodes.name: extractBreedWeightRange
nodes.summary: Parses breed knowledge data to extract min/max adult weight ranges, handling various text formats in the breed knowledge JSON files.

nodes.name: getFallbackRange
nodes.summary: Returns default weight ranges based on species and breed name heuristics (e.g., matching giant breeds by name patterns) when breed-specific knowledge is unavailable.

nodes.name: breed-knowledge-loader.ts
nodes.summary: Loads and caches breed-specific knowledge JSON files from disk, providing typed interfaces for health risks, preventive care, and lifestyle guidance, with TTL-based cache eviction and helper functions for querying breed data.

nodes.name: BreedKnowledgeCache
nodes.summary: TTL-based in-memory cache for breed knowledge data with get/set/has/clear operations and cache statistics reporting.

nodes.name: loadBreedKnowledge
nodes.summary: Loads breed knowledge from a JSON file (by breed name), caching the result with TTL, and returning null if the file is not found or malformed.

nodes.name: offerMetadataValidator.ts
nodes.summary: Zod-based validation schema and helper functions for subscription offer metadata, including safe parse and a utility to extract Stripe price IDs from validated offer objects.

nodes.name: activity-tracker.ts
nodes.summary: Activity tracking utilities that determine user engagement status (active, returning, idle) based on login and insights-viewed timestamps, used to optimize when to generate health summaries in the background.

nodes.name: enums.ts
nodes.summary: Central enum definitions for the entire application, exporting const arrays and derived TypeScript types for species, gender, size, breed details, subscription plans, record types, lookup types, and other domain-specific classifications.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses TypeScript 'as const' pattern with typeof indexing to derive union types from const arrays, providing both runtime values and compile-time types.

nodes.name: schemas.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive Zod validation schemas for all API request bodies including onboarding flows, pet CRUD, weight records, breed lookups, subscriptions, user profiles, and feedback, built on top of the enum constants.

nodes.name: validators.ts
nodes.summary: Provides type-guard validation functions for pet-related enums (gender, species, size, activity level, breed) and Zod schemas for health record metadata (bathroom bowel, urination, symptoms).

nodes.name: periods.ts
nodes.summary: Defines time period constants (day, week, month, quarter, year) with SQL truncation formats, display labels, duration mappings, and a calculateDateRange helper for analytics queries.

nodes.name: rate-limit.ts
nodes.summary: Defines rate limiting constants including time unit multipliers, default windows, allowed paths whitelist, key types, error codes, preset configurations, and environment variable names.

nodes.name: limits.constants.ts
nodes.summary: Defines numeric limits for chat history pagination, symptom counts per pet, health insight context limits, retry attempts with backoff, and minimum sentence length for content validation.

nodes.name: cache-ttl.constants.ts
nodes.summary: Defines cache TTL durations for health summary data, differentiated between free tier (7 days) and premium tier, using MS_PER_DAY from time constants.

nodes.name: time.constants.ts
nodes.summary: Provides fundamental time unit constants in milliseconds (second, minute, hour, day) and a weight trend lookback period in months, used as building blocks across the application.

nodes.name: weight.constants.ts
nodes.summary: Defines weight-related constants including kg-to-lb conversion factor, stable weight threshold percentage for trend detection, and maximum weight records to consider for trend analysis.

nodes.name: auth.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the AuthenticatedUser interface with user identity fields and AuthenticatedRequest that extends FastifyRequest with the authenticated user payload.

nodes.name: breed-types.ts
nodes.summary: Defines TypeScript interfaces for breed-related API operations including filters, CRUD data shapes, and paginated API response types for breed names and breed details.

nodes.name: lookup-types.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive type definitions for the lookup type system covering activities, symptoms, vet visits, and medications, including query params, CRUD request/response shapes, bulk operations, filtering, and error types.

nodes.name: onboarding.ts
nodes.summary: Defines TypeScript interfaces for the user onboarding flow including profile data (terms agreement, owner info), pet data (name, species, gender, neutering status), and the combined onboarding completion payload.

nodes.name: rate-limit.ts
nodes.summary: Defines TypeScript interfaces for rate limiting including JWT payload, rate limit configuration options, error response shapes, context objects, key types, and environment-based configuration for global/API/auth rate limits.

nodes.name: weight.ts
nodes.summary: Defines TypeScript interfaces for pet weight tracking including weight record shape, CRUD data types with Zod schema references, paginated history response with plan-based restrictions, and weight change calculations.

nodes.name: rate-limit.ts
nodes.summary: Configures Fastify rate limiting with JWT-based key derivation, time window parsing, path-based allowlists, and tiered rate limit presets for global, API, and auth endpoints.

nodes.name: chat-persona.config.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the PePe veterinarian chat persona with bilingual (Thai/English) character identity, system prompt generation for Gemini AI chat, pet name formatting helpers, token cost calculation, and response validation.

nodes.name: gemini-models.config.ts
nodes.summary: Centralized Gemini AI model configuration defining model selections, temperature/token settings, and pricing tiers for chat, health insights, health summaries, translation, and title generation use cases with free/premium differentiation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses TypeScript 'as const' assertions extensively for literal type inference on model configuration objects.

nodes.name: calculateDateRange
nodes.summary: Calculates a start/end date range for a given period type with configurable lookback limit, used to scope analytics and health record queries.

nodes.name: parseTimeWindow
nodes.summary: Parses human-readable time window strings (e.g., '5m', '1 hour', '30s') into milliseconds for rate limit configuration.

nodes.name: deriveRateLimitKey
nodes.summary: Extracts a rate limit key from the request by attempting JWT-based user identification first, falling back to IP address.

nodes.name: configureRateLimiting
nodes.summary: Registers the @fastify/rate-limit plugin on a Fastify instance with environment-driven global limits, custom key generation, allowlist, and error response formatting.

nodes.name: generateChatSystemPrompt
nodes.summary: Generates a comprehensive bilingual system prompt for the PePe veterinarian AI persona, including character guidelines, response rules, medical disclaimers, and formatting instructions.

nodes.name: auth.ts
nodes.summary: Authentication route handlers providing a /me endpoint for current user info and a /guard endpoint that validates sessions, initializes new user records on first login, and detects geolocation in the background.

nodes.name: authRoutes
nodes.summary: Fastify plugin registering GET /me and GET /guard routes. The guard endpoint creates user profiles and config records for new users via dynamic imports, tracks onboarding analytics, and performs background geolocation detection.

nodes.name: blog.ts
nodes.summary: Public blog route handlers exposing endpoints to list published posts, get posts by slug, retrieve featured posts, fetch related posts, and increment view counts, all with CDN cache headers.

nodes.name: blogRoutes
nodes.summary: Fastify plugin registering five public blog endpoints: list posts, get by slug, get featured, get related posts, and increment view count. Delegates all business logic to blogService.

nodes.name: breeds.ts
nodes.summary: Breed management route handlers providing CRUD operations, breed listing by species, breed name selectors with language support, bulk insert, count, and cache management endpoints.

nodes.name: breedRoutes
nodes.summary: Fastify plugin with 10 breed endpoints: list with filters, by species, name selectors with caching and i18n, bulk insert, count, cache management, single breed lookup, create, update, and delete. Uses Zod for inline body validation.

nodes.name: chat.ts
nodes.summary: Generic AI chat route handlers supporting text and multipart image uploads. Validates user has pets and an active subscription, then delegates to the chat orchestrator service for conversation room management, rate limiting, and AI responses.

nodes.name: chatRoutes
nodes.summary: Fastify plugin with GET /history for paginated chat history and POST / for sending messages. POST handler supports JSON and multipart form data with up to 5 images (10MB each), checks pet ownership and subscription tier, then delegates to chatOrchestratorService.

nodes.name: chat-suggestions.ts
nodes.summary: Provides a single authenticated endpoint that returns contextual chat suggestions based on pet data using a zero-cost template-based approach without LLM calls.

nodes.name: feedback.ts
nodes.summary: Authenticated feedback route handlers with endpoints to submit new feedback and retrieve a user's feedback history, delegating to feedbackService.

nodes.name: external-domains.ts
nodes.summary: Public endpoint returning a list of active external domain strings from the database, used by the iOS app for configuration without authentication.

nodes.name: helper.ts
nodes.summary: Public 'Share with Helper' route handlers enabling unauthenticated pet caretakers (family, sitters) to view pet info, create/update/delete care log entries via JWT or short-code token authentication with in-memory rate limiting.

nodes.name: resolveToken
nodes.summary: Resolves a short code (10-char alphanumeric) to a full JWT token via helperTokenService, or passes through a JWT token directly. Used by all helper route handlers.

nodes.name: helperRoutes
nodes.summary: Fastify plugin with wildcard GET/POST/PUT/DELETE routes for the helper feature. GET returns pet info and helper's logs; POST creates log entries with type validation; PUT updates notes on own logs; DELETE performs soft-delete. All routes use rate limiting and JWT/short-code token verification.

nodes.name: lookupTypes.ts
nodes.summary: CRUD route handlers for pet record lookup types (activity, symptom, vet_visit, medication) with endpoints for listing, filtering by species, getting by ID, creating, updating, deleting, bulk creation, and statistics.

nodes.name: lookupTypesRoutes
nodes.summary: Fastify plugin with 8 endpoints managing lookup types: GET by type with query filters, GET all species types, GET by ID, POST create, PUT update, DELETE, POST bulk create, and GET stats. Uses Zod schemas from constants for validation.

nodes.name: notifications.ts
nodes.summary: Notification route handlers providing endpoints for retrieving notification settings filtered by user consent preferences, listing user notification history with pagination, getting unread counts, and marking notifications as read.

nodes.name: notificationRoutes
nodes.summary: Fastify plugin with 5 endpoints: GET /settings returns active notifications filtered by user's reminder/marketing consent; GET / lists paginated notification history; GET /unread-count; PATCH /:id/read marks single as read; POST /mark-all-read marks all as read.

nodes.name: offers.ts
nodes.summary: Fastify route plugin for promotional offers, providing endpoints to trigger offers, fetch active offers, mark offers as shown, and track offer-related analytics events.

nodes.name: paymentMethods.ts
nodes.summary: Fastify route plugin for Stripe payment method management, including setup intents, listing/updating/deleting payment methods, setting defaults, and retrieving invoices and upcoming invoices.

nodes.name: pet-chat.ts
nodes.summary: Fastify route plugin for AI-powered pet health chat, enabling users to send messages about their pets, retrieve chat history and stats, clear conversations, and check rate limit status based on subscription tier.

nodes.name: pet-insights.ts
nodes.summary: Fastify route plugin for AI-generated pet health insights, providing endpoints to get/regenerate/delete insights and health summaries with tier-based access control (free vs premium), 7-day refresh rate limits for insights and 24-hour limits for summaries, and breed availability checks.
nodes.languageNotes: Directly queries DB with Drizzle ORM in route handlers for subscription verification rather than delegating to service layer, which is atypical for this project's architecture.

nodes.name: petRecord.ts
nodes.summary: Fastify route plugin for pet health records CRUD operations including single and bulk record creation, timeline access with shared-pet support, record updates/deletes with ownership verification, and lookup type retrieval for record categories.

nodes.name: petWeight.ts
nodes.summary: Fastify route plugin for pet weight tracking, providing CRUD endpoints to log, list, update, and delete weight entries for a specific pet with authentication and pet access middleware.

nodes.name: pets.ts
nodes.summary: Fastify route plugin for core pet management including pet CRUD, profile image uploads via Bunny CDN, listing user's pets with subscription-aware access control, and generating share/helper tokens for collaborative pet care.

nodes.name: push.ts
nodes.summary: Fastify route plugin for push notification device token management, providing endpoints to register and unregister device tokens (iOS/Android) with direct Drizzle ORM database operations.

nodes.name: reminders.ts
nodes.summary: Fastify route plugin for pet care reminders supporting CRUD operations with Zod-validated reminder creation (medication, vet appointments, grooming, custom types), multi-pet assignment, recurring schedules (daily/weekly/monthly), and completion tracking with direct Drizzle ORM queries.

nodes.name: scheduled-offers.ts
nodes.summary: Fastify route plugin for automated scheduled offer management, providing endpoints to trigger welcome offers, trigger monthly offers, check next scheduled offer times, and retrieve offer configuration settings.

nodes.name: paymentMethodRoutes
nodes.summary: Fastify plugin function that registers all payment method routes including setup intent creation, payment method listing, default setting, deletion, and invoice retrieval, delegating business logic to stripeService.

nodes.name: getUserTier
nodes.summary: Helper function that determines a user's subscription tier (free or premium) by querying the subscription service.

nodes.name: share.ts
nodes.summary: Public 'Share with Vet' route that resolves a short-code or JWT token and returns a pet health summary including profile, weight, symptoms, medications, and vet visits, respecting the owner's subscription plan history limits.

nodes.name: shareRoutes
nodes.summary: Fastify route plugin that registers a wildcard GET endpoint to verify share tokens, fetch pet data with breed and weight info, query health records within plan-based history limits, and return grouped records for vet viewing.

nodes.name: stripe.ts
nodes.summary: Stripe webhook handler that verifies signatures, performs idempotency checks against the subscription_events table, dispatches events to stripeWebhookService by type (checkout, subscription lifecycle, invoices, payment methods), and records processed events.

nodes.name: stripeRoutes
nodes.summary: Registers a POST /webhook endpoint that validates Stripe signatures, deduplicates events via DB lookup, dispatches to appropriate webhook handlers based on event type, and persists the event for idempotency.

nodes.name: subscriptions.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive subscription management routes providing endpoints for viewing subscription status, pricing, Stripe checkout session creation with offer/promo support, billing portal, plan upgrades with proration preview, cancellation with winback offer triggers, resume, history, sync, and confirm flows.

nodes.name: subscriptionRoutes
nodes.summary: Fastify plugin registering 12+ subscription endpoints: GET/POST/PUT /me for CRUD, /pricing (public), /checkout with rate limiting and offer-linked price resolution, /portal, /preview-upgrade, /upgrade, /cancel with winback trigger, /resume, /history, /sync, /confirm, and /force-sync.

nodes.name: users.ts
nodes.summary: User-facing route module handling dashboard data aggregation, profile CRUD with image upload via BunnyCDN, multi-step onboarding flow (name, demographics, finalize with welcome offer), onboarding analytics tracking, personalization settings, weight unit preferences, and soft account deletion.

nodes.name: userRoutes
nodes.summary: Fastify plugin with 15+ endpoints: /dashboard (parallel data fetch), /profile (GET/POST/PATCH with image upload), /onboarding/* (name, demographics, finalize with welcome offer, track analytics), /personalization, /settings/weight-unit, and /delete-account (soft delete).

nodes.name: language-preferences.ts
nodes.summary: Simple route module providing GET and PATCH endpoints for user language preference (Thai or English), reading and writing through the userConfigService.

nodes.name: notification-preferences.ts
nodes.summary: Route module providing GET and PATCH endpoints for user notification consent preferences (reminder and marketing), delegating to userConfigService and maintaining backward-compatible response format.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Admin route aggregator that registers 15 sub-route plugins (auth, admins, users, subscriptions, analytics, onboarding-analytics, settings, feedback, blog, dev-tools, external-domains, user-demographics, lookup-types, pricing, pets) under their respective prefixes.

nodes.name: admins.ts
nodes.summary: Admin management CRUD routes providing list, get-by-id, create, update, delete, and change-password endpoints for admin accounts, all protected by admin authentication and 'admin:manage' permission with Zod validation.

nodes.name: adminManagementRoutes
nodes.summary: Fastify plugin registering 6 admin management endpoints (GET /, GET /:id, POST /, PUT /:id, DELETE /:id, POST /:id/password) with role-based permission guards, self-deletion prevention, and last-super-admin protection.

nodes.name: analytics.ts
nodes.summary: Admin analytics routes providing dashboard metrics, user trends, share analytics (vet and helper shares with category breakdowns), LLM business metrics (adoption, conversion funnels, power users), and offer analytics (overview, funnel, performance, timeline) endpoints.

nodes.name: adminAnalyticsRoutes
nodes.summary: Fastify plugin registering 8 analytics endpoints: /dashboard, /trends, /shares (with inline DB queries for vet/helper share stats and category breakdowns), /llm/business (adoption and conversion metrics), and /offers/* (overview, funnel, performance, timeline) delegating to offerAnalyticsService.

nodes.name: auth.ts
nodes.summary: Admin authentication routes providing login (with IP and user-agent capture), get-current-admin (/me), and logout endpoints with audit logging, delegating credential verification to adminAuthService.

nodes.name: adminAuthRoutes
nodes.summary: Fastify plugin registering POST /login (validates credentials via adminAuthService with IP/user-agent), GET /me (returns current admin info), and POST /logout (logs audit action) endpoints.

nodes.name: blog.ts
nodes.summary: Admin route handlers for blog post management including CRUD operations, publishing/unpublishing, and image upload via Bunny CDN. Uses Zod schemas for input validation and delegates to blogService.

nodes.name: dev-tools.ts
nodes.summary: Super-admin-only developer tools routes providing dangerous operations like hard-deleting users with all associated data. Directly queries the database via Drizzle ORM rather than delegating to a service layer.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses FastifyPluginAsync pattern instead of the default export async function pattern used by other route files.

nodes.name: external-domains.ts
nodes.summary: Admin CRUD routes for managing external domains (whitelist). Directly queries the externalDomains table via Drizzle ORM with Zod validation for create and update operations.

nodes.name: feedback.ts
nodes.summary: Admin routes for viewing, filtering, and archiving user feedback. Supports pagination and filtering by plan, rating, locale, and date range, delegating to adminFeedbackService.

nodes.name: lookupTypes.ts
nodes.summary: Admin routes for managing pet record lookup types (activities, symptoms, vet visits, medications). Provides CRUD with filtering by type, species, and status, delegating to lookupTypeService.

nodes.name: onboarding-analytics.ts
nodes.summary: Admin analytics routes for onboarding metrics including overview stats, funnel analysis, drop-off points, and retention cohorts. Delegates to onboardingAnalyticsService with configurable time periods.

nodes.name: pets.ts
nodes.summary: Minimal admin route to retrieve all pets for a specific user by userId. Includes language resolution from query params or Accept-Language header, delegating to petAdminService.

nodes.name: resolveLang
nodes.summary: Resolves the preferred language ('en' or 'th') from the request query parameter or Accept-Language header, returning undefined if neither matches.

nodes.name: pricing.ts
nodes.summary: Super-admin pricing configuration routes for managing Stripe price IDs across plans, billing cycles, and currencies. Supports viewing, updating, validating, and auditing pricing changes via pricingConfigService.

nodes.name: settings.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive admin settings routes covering audit log viewing/stats, admin account management (CRUD, role changes, password resets), notification settings, and API key generation. Restricted to super_admin role for most operations.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest route file at ~700 lines, exceeding the project's recommended 300-line limit for route files.

nodes.name: subscriptions.ts
nodes.summary: Admin routes for subscription management including overview statistics, paginated subscription listings with filters, and individual user subscription details. Delegates to adminSubscriptionService.

nodes.name: userDemographics.ts
nodes.summary: Admin route providing comprehensive user demographics data including country distribution with enriched country names. Delegates to userDemographicsService with no authentication middleware configured.

nodes.name: users.ts
nodes.summary: Admin routes for user management including paginated user listing, user detail view, status toggling, profile updates, admin notes, and user statistics. Uses Zod schemas for validation and delegates to adminUserService.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file that re-exports all 33 service singletons from the services directory, providing a single import point for the entire service layer.

nodes.name: userService.ts
nodes.summary: Manages user profiles and personalization including CRUD operations, onboarding flow (profile, pet, completion), soft-delete/restore, admin access to profiles, display name, demographics, and detected country.
nodes.languageNotes: Exports class and singleton instance pattern used across all services. Uses Drizzle ORM with Zod validation schemas.

nodes.name: petService.ts
nodes.summary: Handles pet CRUD operations with breed-enriched data, ownership verification, access control checks, paginated listing, onboarding pet creation, and profile image management via Bunny CDN.

nodes.name: petRecordServices.ts
nodes.summary: Manages pet health records (activities, symptoms, vet visits, medications) with daily limits, bulk creation, timeline queries with subscription-based date restrictions, and lookup type enrichment.

nodes.name: petWeightService.ts
nodes.summary: Tracks pet weight records with hourly and daily rate limits, weight change calculations (kg and percentage), subscription-based history restrictions, and ownership verification.

nodes.name: breedService.ts
nodes.summary: Provides breed data operations including paginated listing with species/search filters, breed name lookups with in-memory TTL caching, bulk insert, and species-specific breed counts.

nodes.name: blogService.ts
nodes.summary: Full blog post lifecycle management with locale-aware content (en/th), status transitions (draft, published, hidden, archived), featured post management, slug validation, reading time calculation, and frontend-formatted output.

nodes.name: feedbackService.ts
nodes.summary: Simple CRUD service for user feedback submissions with Zod validation, supporting creation, retrieval by user, and retrieval by ID.

nodes.name: lookupTypeService.ts
nodes.summary: Admin-facing service for managing pet record type lookups (activities, symptoms, vet visits, medications) with species-scoped CRUD, usage statistics, audit logging, bulk creation, and status toggling.

nodes.name: gemini-service.ts
nodes.summary: Wraps the Google Gemini generative AI API for pet health insight generation, general text/image generation, and multi-turn chat with configurable model tiers, retry logic with exponential backoff, and token counting.
nodes.languageNotes: Exports multiple interfaces (PetProfile, GeneratedInsight, GeminiHealthInsightsResponse) alongside the service class. Uses a lazy singleton via getGeminiService factory function.

nodes.name: UserService
nodes.summary: Service class handling user profile CRUD, personalization preferences, multi-step onboarding flow, soft-delete lifecycle, and admin-level user data access.

nodes.name: PetService
nodes.summary: Service class for pet lifecycle management including breed-enriched queries, ownership verification, subscription-aware access control, pagination, and CDN image uploads.

nodes.name: PetRecordService
nodes.summary: Service class managing pet health record CRUD with daily limits, bulk creation, timeline queries with subscription-based restrictions, and record type enrichment from lookup tables.

nodes.name: PetWeightService
nodes.summary: Service class for pet weight tracking with hourly/daily rate limits, weight change calculations, subscription-aware history access, and soft-delete support.

nodes.name: BreedService
nodes.summary: Service class providing breed data with paginated search, in-memory cache for breed name selectors, species-based filtering, and bulk insert capability.

nodes.name: BlogService
nodes.summary: Service class for blog post management with locale-aware author names, reading time estimation, status workflow (draft/publish/hide/archive), featured post logic, slug uniqueness checks, and view counting.

nodes.name: FeedbackService
nodes.summary: Simple service class for creating and retrieving user feedback entries with Zod validation.

nodes.name: LookupTypeService
nodes.summary: Admin service class for managing pet record type definitions with species-scoped queries, usage statistics across record tables, audit trail logging, and bulk creation.

nodes.name: GeminiService
nodes.summary: Core AI service wrapping Google Gemini API with model tier selection, health insight generation for pets, text/image generation, multi-turn chat with conversation history, retry with exponential backoff, and token counting.

nodes.name: orchestrator.service.ts
nodes.summary: Main coordinator for the pet chat feature that orchestrates rate limiting, validation, context retrieval, prompt building, Gemini LLM generation, image upload to CDN, message persistence, and async title generation into a single sendMessage flow. Also exposes chat history, stats, and rate limit check endpoints.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses fire-and-forget Promise pattern for non-blocking title generation after chat response.

nodes.name: ChatOrchestratorService
nodes.summary: Singleton service class that coordinates the full chat lifecycle: rate limit check, input validation, pet context aggregation, prompt construction, Gemini API call with vision support, CDN image upload, message persistence, and background title generation.

nodes.name: sendMessage
nodes.summary: Core chat method that executes the full pipeline: context loading, rate limiting, validation, history retrieval, prompt building, Gemini LLM call (with optional image vision), CDN upload, message persistence, usage recording, and async title generation for first messages in a conversation.

nodes.name: context.service.ts
nodes.summary: Aggregates pet profile data (breed, age, weight trend, health risks, recent symptoms) and user preferences into a structured context object for personalized chat responses. Uses batched DB queries to avoid N+1 when loading all user pets, and formats bilingual (Thai/English) context strings for the LLM.

nodes.name: ChatContextService
nodes.summary: Aggregates pet profiles, weight trends, health insights, recent symptoms, and user config into a ChatContext object. Provides both single-pet and multi-pet context methods with batched queries and bilingual formatting for LLM consumption.

nodes.name: getAllPetsContext
nodes.summary: Loads context for all of a user's pets using four batched DB queries (pets+breeds, weight records, insights, symptoms) to avoid N+1, then assembles PetContext objects and builds a multi-pet conversation context string.

nodes.name: history.service.ts
nodes.summary: Manages chat message persistence and retrieval with Drizzle ORM, including saving messages, paginated conversation history (per-pet and per-user), token-budgeted recent message retrieval for LLM context (bloat protection capping at ~2000 tokens), deletion, rejection marking, and conversation statistics.

nodes.name: ChatHistoryService
nodes.summary: Provides CRUD operations for pet chat messages including save, paginated retrieval (per-pet and per-user), token-budget-aware recent message fetching for LLM context, conversation/message deletion, rejection marking, and conversation statistics aggregation.

nodes.name: getRecentMessages
nodes.summary: Retrieves recent non-rejected messages for LLM context with token-based bloat protection: fetches up to 20 messages but only includes those fitting within a ~2000 token budget, always guaranteeing at least 4 messages (2 exchanges) for minimum context.

nodes.name: prompt-builder.service.ts
nodes.summary: Constructs LLM prompts by combining the PEPE AI persona system prompt, pet context (profile, health, risks), conversation history, and current user question. Separates cacheable content (persona + context) from dynamic content (history + question) to optimize Gemini context caching for cost savings.

nodes.name: ChatPromptBuilderService
nodes.summary: Builds structured prompts for Gemini LLM by assembling system prompt (PEPE persona), pet context, conversation history, and current question into cacheable and dynamic components with bilingual support (Thai/English).

nodes.name: rate-limit.service.ts
nodes.summary: Manages daily rate limiting for the pet chat feature with tier-based limits (10 free / 30 premium messages per day), user blocking/unblocking with expiry support, and usage tracking via upsert on a per-day basis.

nodes.name: ChatRateLimitService
nodes.summary: Enforces daily chat message limits per subscription tier (free: 10, premium: 30), checks and auto-expires user blocks, records message usage with upsert, and provides admin user-blocking functionality.

nodes.name: suggestion.service.ts
nodes.summary: Generates contextual chat suggestions for users based on pet data using 12 template patterns (breed risks, age care, weight trends, neutering, dental, nutrition, behavior, grooming, seasonal). Zero LLM cost with instant response via template matching and Fisher-Yates shuffle.

nodes.name: ChatSuggestionService
nodes.summary: Generates 3-4 contextual chat suggestions by matching 12 template categories (breed health risks, age-appropriate care, weight trends, neutering, dental, nutrition, behavior, grooming, exercise, checkups, seasonal, multi-pet) against pet context data with bilingual support.

nodes.name: title-generator.service.ts
nodes.summary: Generates short 3-5 word conversation titles using Gemini Flash Lite for chat history sidebar display. Runs asynchronously as fire-and-forget, cleans generated titles (removes quotes/markdown, limits to 60 chars), and persists them to the database.

nodes.name: ChatTitleGeneratorService
nodes.summary: Generates and persists conversation titles using Gemini Flash Lite. Provides async fire-and-forget title generation, title cleanup (quote/markdown removal), existence checking, and admin regeneration with bilingual prompt support.

nodes.name: validation.service.ts
nodes.summary: Validates user chat messages with basic length checking (3-1000 chars). Content appropriateness and topic filtering are delegated to the LLM. Provides bilingual rejection messages in Thai and English.

nodes.name: ChatValidationService
nodes.summary: Performs basic message length validation (3-1000 chars) with bilingual rejection messages. The deprecated validate() method delegates to validateBasic() since content filtering is now handled by the LLM.

nodes.name: cleanup.service.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-cleanup service for old chat messages with conversation-aware deletion (deletes entire conversations where all messages are older than 3 months). Provides dry-run preview, storage statistics for admin dashboard, and manual cleanup with configurable retention (minimum 7 days).

nodes.name: ChatCleanupService
nodes.summary: Manages chat message retention with conversation-aware cleanup (never breaks up conversations), 7-day safety net, cleanup preview/dry-run, storage statistics for admin dashboards, and manual cleanup with configurable retention period.

nodes.name: suggestion.service.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for ChatSuggestionService covering fallback suggestions, bilingual output (Thai/English), contextual suggestions for various pet profiles (puppies, seniors, cats, overweight pets, unneutered pets), suggestion count validation (3-4), error handling, and randomization behavior.

nodes.name: orchestrator.service.ts
nodes.summary: Main orchestrator that coordinates the full health insights generation pipeline: context resolution, strategy routing (cache/generate/rate-limit), knowledge processing, LLM prompt building, post-processing, subscription filtering, and health summary generation with tier-aware caching and rate limiting.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses dynamic imports extensively (await import()) for lazy loading of services like health-summary-rate-limit and weight-validation, and Promise.race for timeout handling.

nodes.name: InsightsOrchestratorService
nodes.summary: Singleton service class that orchestrates the full insight generation pipeline including cache management, LLM invocation, health summary generation with tier-aware TTLs (free: 30d, premium: 7d), view tracking for analytics, and refresh eligibility checks.

nodes.name: strategy-router.service.ts
nodes.summary: Determines the generation strategy for health insights by checking database-backed cache (30-day TTL), enforcing per-pet and per-user rate limits, and detecting subscription tier mismatches to trigger regeneration. Contains no LLM logic.

nodes.name: StrategyRouterService
nodes.summary: Routes insight generation requests through cache check, tier mismatch detection, and multi-level rate limiting (per-pet daily, per-user hourly/daily) to decide CACHE_HIT, GENERATE, or RATE_LIMITED actions. Fails open on errors.

nodes.name: context-resolver.service.ts
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for request context in health insights generation. Resolves pet profile (with breed join and weight lookup), user subscription tier via accessControlService, and determines effective locale with priority: request > user preference > default Thai.

nodes.name: ContextResolverService
nodes.summary: Fetches and assembles pet context (breed, weight, age), user context (locale, subscription tier), and validates pet ownership. Throws specific error codes for breed validation failures (BREED_MISSING, BREED_CORRUPTED).

nodes.name: knowledge-processor.service.ts
nodes.summary: Processes breed-specific health knowledge from JSON files: filters risks and preventive care by pet age with a 36-month relevance buffer, pre-assigns risk levels from severity data, sorts by relevance, and optionally translates warning signs to Thai via Gemini LLM.

nodes.name: KnowledgeProcessorService
nodes.summary: Loads breed knowledge, filters health risks and preventive care by pet age relevance, maps severity to risk levels, limits output counts (7 risks, 6 care items), and performs batch translation of warning signs to Thai using Gemini with graceful fallback to English.

nodes.name: prompt-builder.service.ts
nodes.summary: Builds structured LLM prompts for health insight content generation. Constructs a system prompt with PePe veterinarian persona and constraints, and a user prompt with pet profile, pre-categorized insights, naming rules, and recent symptoms. Applies tier-based insight selection (free: 3, premium: up to 9).

nodes.name: PromptBuilderService
nodes.summary: Assembles system and user prompts for LLM health insight generation, selecting insight counts by subscription tier (free: 1 high + 1 medium + 1 low, premium: 4 high + 3 medium + 2 low) and formatting pet context with locale-aware naming rules.

nodes.name: post-processor.service.ts
nodes.summary: Validates LLM JSON output, merges LLM-generated content (titles, descriptions, recommendations) with system-determined metadata (categories, risk levels), maps field names to frontend expectations, and stores complete insights in the database with tier markers.

nodes.name: PostProcessorService
nodes.summary: Parses and validates LLM output JSON, merges generated content with system metadata using insightKey lookups, maps field names for frontend compatibility (summary->description, prevention->recommendations), and atomically replaces old insights in the database.

nodes.name: dummy-card-generator.service.ts
nodes.summary: Generates blurred/locked dummy insight cards for free-tier users to drive premium upgrades. Selects 1 real insight per risk level plus 2 dummy cards per level (9 total), with localized FOMO-inducing descriptions and upgrade messaging in Thai and English.

nodes.name: DummyCardGeneratorService
nodes.summary: Creates a free-tier response mixing 3 real insights (one per risk level) with 6 blurred dummy cards containing localized placeholder titles/descriptions and upgrade CTAs, calculating hidden insight counts to encourage premium conversion.

nodes.name: activity-summary.service.ts
nodes.summary: Queries and summarizes pet activities from the last 30 days (activities, symptoms, vet visits, medications, weight records, and average vibe rating) to provide contextual data for health summary LLM prompts.

nodes.name: ActivitySummaryService
nodes.summary: Queries petRecords and petWeightRecords for the last 30 days, categorizes by type (activity, symptom, vet_visit, medication), calculates average vibe rating, and returns a gracefully-degrading summary that never fails the parent operation.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file that re-exports all insight generation services and types from the modular architecture: context resolver, strategy router, knowledge processor, prompt builder, post-processor, dummy card generator, and orchestrator.

nodes.name: recent-symptoms.service.ts
nodes.summary: Fetches and enriches recent symptom records (last 7 days) with type metadata from petRecordTypes, supports single-pet and batch multi-pet queries to avoid N+1, and formats symptoms as localized markdown for LLM context in chat and health insight orchestrators.

nodes.name: RecentSymptomsService
nodes.summary: Provides getRecentSymptoms (single pet), getRecentSymptomsForPets (batch N+1 optimized), and formatSymptomsForContext (Thai/English markdown with severity, frequency, and duration maps). Enriches raw records with type names and calculates days-ago for display.

nodes.name: stripeService.ts
nodes.summary: Core Stripe integration service handling checkout sessions, subscriptions, billing portal, payment methods, invoices, and subscription lifecycle operations (upgrade, cancel, sync). Exports a singleton object with 15+ methods that wrap the Stripe API.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses module-scoped helper functions (getPriceId, ensureCustomerForUser) alongside an exported object literal with async methods, a common pattern for service singletons in this codebase.

nodes.name: stripeWebhookService.ts
nodes.summary: Handles all Stripe webhook event business logic including checkout completion, subscription updates/deletions, invoice payments, payment method attachments, and failed payments. Triggers offer analytics tracking, access control cache invalidation, and background health insight regeneration on plan changes.

nodes.name: subscriptionService.ts
nodes.summary: Provides basic CRUD operations for user subscription records including get, ensure (upsert with free plan default), getPlanRule (with fallback defaults), and createOrUpdate with Zod validation. Invalidates access control cache on changes.

nodes.name: adminSubscriptionService.ts
nodes.summary: Admin-facing subscription management service providing CRUD operations on user subscriptions, including listing with filtering/pagination, plan changes, cancellation, Stripe sync, and subscription statistics aggregation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Drizzle ORM query builder extensively with dynamic where clauses and sorting. Exports both the class and a singleton instance.

nodes.name: pricingService.ts
nodes.summary: Fetches and formats live pricing information from Stripe for both THB and USD currencies across monthly, yearly discounted, and yearly default tiers. Provides savings calculation for yearly vs monthly comparisons.

nodes.name: pricingConfigService.ts
nodes.summary: Manages Stripe price ID configuration with a three-tier resolution strategy: in-memory cache, database lookup, and environment variable fallback. Provides CRUD for pricing configs, price validation against Stripe, history tracking, and diagnostic info for troubleshooting pricing issues.

nodes.name: offerService.ts
nodes.summary: Manages subscription promotional offer lifecycle including triggering time-limited discount offers, checking cooldown periods, retrieving active offers, and marking offers as redeemed or dismissed. Validates offer metadata before persisting and tracks analytics events.

nodes.name: scheduledOfferService.ts
nodes.summary: Orchestrates automated offer triggering, primarily welcome offers for new users based on signup date with configurable window hours. Handles re-engagement offers for lapsed users and batch offer processing for eligible free-tier users.

nodes.name: offerAnalyticsService.ts
nodes.summary: Tracks and analyzes subscription offer funnel metrics including impressions, clicks, checkout starts, conversions, expirations, and dismissals. Provides aggregate analytics, per-offer performance breakdowns, and funnel visualization data with conversion rate calculations.

nodes.name: StripeWebhookService
nodes.summary: Handles all Stripe webhook event types with dedicated methods for checkout completion, subscription CRUD, invoice payments (success/failure), setup intents, and payment method attachments. Each handler returns the affected userId for idempotency tracking.

nodes.name: SubscriptionService
nodes.summary: Manages user subscription CRUD with methods for get, ensure (upsert free plan), getPlanRule (with hardcoded fallbacks), createOrUpdate (with Zod validation), and update. Invalidates access control cache after mutations.

nodes.name: SubscriptionValidator
nodes.summary: Static validation helper that checks whether subscription state transitions (cancel, change plan, sync) are permitted based on current plan, status, and expiry dates.

nodes.name: AdminSubscriptionService
nodes.summary: Core admin subscription service with methods for listing subscriptions with pagination and filtering, fetching by user ID, computing stats, changing plans via database transactions, cancelling subscriptions through Stripe, and syncing subscription state with Stripe.

nodes.name: ensureCustomerForUser
nodes.summary: Ensures a valid Stripe customer exists for a user by checking the stored customer ID, verifying it with Stripe, and creating a new customer if the stored ID is invalid or missing.

nodes.name: resolvePlanCycleFromPriceId
nodes.summary: Resolves a Stripe price ID to its corresponding plan and billing cycle by querying active pricing configs, falling back to environment variable mapping for backward compatibility.

nodes.name: regenerateInsightsInBackground
nodes.summary: Fire-and-forget background task that regenerates health insights for all pets belonging to a user after a premium upgrade, processing sequentially to avoid overwhelming the LLM API.

nodes.name: fetchPriceDetails
nodes.summary: Fetches a Stripe price by ID and formats it into a PriceInfo object with display amount, currency, and interval details.

nodes.name: pushService.ts
nodes.summary: Manages Apple Push Notification service (APNs) integration, handling provider initialization from environment variables, sending push notifications to user devices, tracking delivery status in the database, and deactivating invalid device tokens.

nodes.name: PushService
nodes.summary: Singleton class that initializes APNs provider (supporting both base64-encoded keys for cloud deployments and file paths for local dev), sends push notifications to all active user devices, creates notification records, and handles token lifecycle including deactivation of invalid tokens.

nodes.name: notificationService.ts
nodes.summary: Provides user-facing notification operations including paginated retrieval, marking notifications as read (individual and bulk), and unread count queries against the notifications table.

nodes.name: NotificationService
nodes.summary: Service class for user notification management with methods for paginated listing, marking as read (single and bulk), and unread count retrieval.

nodes.name: notificationSchedulingService.ts
nodes.summary: Pure logic module for determining whether a scheduled notification should be sent today, supporting recurring, specific-date, day-of-week, and day-of-month schedule types, plus consent and tier-based filtering helpers.

nodes.name: shouldSendNotificationToday
nodes.summary: Main exported function that dispatches to the appropriate schedule-type checker (recurring, specific_dates, days_of_week, days_of_month) to determine whether a notification setting should fire for a given user time.

nodes.name: notificationSettingsService.ts
nodes.summary: Full CRUD service for notification settings and the global notification config, supporting admin operations (create, update, toggle, archive/unarchive, delete) and user-facing filtered retrieval with consent-based filtering.

nodes.name: NotificationSettingsService
nodes.summary: Manages the global notification on/off config and individual notification setting CRUD with validation, soft-delete via archiving, consent-aware filtering for mobile clients, and admin audit tracking.

nodes.name: accessControlService.ts
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for subscription-based access control, determining effective plan/status from subscription state (trial, cancelling, past_due, grace periods), with caching, auto-fix for inconsistent data, and bulk expiration cleanup jobs.

nodes.name: AccessControlService
nodes.summary: Evaluates user subscription state to determine premium access, handling trial expiry, cancellation, grace periods, and past-due states. Includes 30s in-memory caching, auto-fix for stale subscription records, and batch jobs for expired subscription/grace period cleanup.

nodes.name: adminAnalyticsService.ts
nodes.summary: Provides admin dashboard analytics including user metrics (total, active, premium, new signups), configurable time-period user growth trends, and audit log management with pagination, filtering, statistics, and retention-based cleanup/purge.

nodes.name: AdminAnalyticsService
nodes.summary: Admin analytics class providing dashboard metrics aggregation, time-series trend queries (new users, premium, active) with configurable periods, paginated audit log retrieval with email/action/date filtering, and audit log lifecycle management (stats, cleanup, purge).

nodes.name: adminAuthService.ts
nodes.summary: Handles admin authentication including login with bcrypt password verification and JWT token generation, admin profile retrieval with permissions, admin creation with role-based permissions, and password change with audit logging.

nodes.name: AdminAuthService
nodes.summary: Admin authentication service with bcrypt-based login, JWT token generation via adminAuth middleware, permission loading, admin user creation, and password change operations with async audit log tracking.

nodes.name: adminFeedbackService.ts
nodes.summary: Admin-facing feedback management service providing paginated feedback listing with user info joins and multi-criteria filtering (plan, rating, locale, date range, archived status), individual feedback retrieval, archive/unarchive operations, and feedback statistics aggregation.

nodes.name: AdminFeedbackService
nodes.summary: Provides paginated feedback queries with user profile joins, multi-filter support (plan, rating, locale, date range, archived status), soft-archive/unarchive, and feedback statistics grouped by plan and rating.

nodes.name: adminManagementService.ts
nodes.summary: Full lifecycle management for admin accounts including listing, creation with hashed passwords, updates with super_admin protection, deletion with pre-delete audit logging, and password changes, all with audit trail integration.

nodes.name: AdminManagementService
nodes.summary: Manages admin user CRUD operations with bcrypt password hashing, role/permission management, super_admin safeguard preventing deletion/deactivation of the last super admin, and comprehensive audit logging for all mutations.

nodes.name: adminUserService.ts
nodes.summary: Admin service for end-user management, providing paginated user listing with Supabase email search integration, detailed user profiles with subscriptions/pets/personalization, user status toggling, profile editing, statistics, user notes CRUD, and Supabase-based password reset.

nodes.name: AdminUserService
nodes.summary: Comprehensive admin user management service with paginated user listing (including Supabase Auth email search), full user detail view aggregating profile/subscription/personalization/pets, user status toggle, profile updates via userConfigService, statistics, admin notes, and password reset via Supabase Admin API.

nodes.name: petAdminService.ts
nodes.summary: Admin-facing pet management service that provides CRUD operations, pagination, search by name, filtering by species, and complete pet data retrieval including breed joins for administrative use.

nodes.name: PetAdminService
nodes.summary: Provides admin-level pet data access including paginated listing, name/species search, CRUD with Zod schema validation, and complete pet data retrieval with breed information via left joins.

nodes.name: userConfigService.ts
nodes.summary: Manages per-user configuration flags and settings including language preference, weight unit, notification consent tracking, and welcome offer state, using an upsert pattern for atomic config creation.

nodes.name: userDemographicsService.ts
nodes.summary: Analytics service that aggregates user demographics data including country distribution, age range breakdown, and gender distribution, with detailed drill-down capabilities for admin reporting.

nodes.name: UserDemographicsService
nodes.summary: Queries and aggregates user profile data to produce demographic summaries (country, age range, gender distributions) and detailed breakdowns with SQL-level grouping and counting.

nodes.name: onboardingAnalyticsService.ts
nodes.summary: Tracks and analyzes user onboarding funnel steps (signup through completion), providing funnel conversion rates, trend analysis, per-step completion statistics, cohort analysis, and overview dashboards.

nodes.name: OnboardingAnalyticsService
nodes.summary: Full onboarding analytics engine that tracks step completions idempotently via upsert, computes funnel conversion/drop-off rates, generates time-series trends, calculates per-step completion stats with average completion times, and provides cohort-based analysis.

nodes.name: startupService.ts
nodes.summary: Application initialization service that runs database migrations on startup, schedules periodic background tasks (subscription expiry fixes, grace period checks, monthly maintenance, cleanup), and provides health check status.

nodes.name: StartupService
nodes.summary: Manages application lifecycle including initialization with migration execution, periodic task scheduling via setInterval (subscription fixes, grace period checks, monthly maintenance, offer cleanup), and health status reporting.

nodes.name: migrationService.ts
nodes.summary: Database migration service that connects directly to PostgreSQL to run Drizzle ORM migrations, check for pending migrations, retrieve current schema version, and report migration health status.

nodes.name: MigrationService
nodes.summary: Handles database migration lifecycle using a dedicated postgres connection and Drizzle migrator, including pending migration detection, schema version tracking, migration execution with console log capture, and health check reporting.

nodes.name: helperTokenService.ts
nodes.summary: JWT-based helper token service for generating, verifying, and resolving short-code tokens used for helper/caretaker access sharing, backed by the helperTokens database table.

nodes.name: HelperTokenService
nodes.summary: Generates JWT tokens with nanoid short codes for helper access, stores them in the database with expiry, and provides verification, short-code resolution, expiry checking, and safe decoding methods.

nodes.name: geolocationService.ts
nodes.summary: IP-based geolocation service that detects user country codes via the ipapi.co API, with timeout handling, private IP filtering, IP masking for privacy, and request IP extraction from headers.

nodes.name: GeolocationService
nodes.summary: Calls ipapi.co to resolve IP addresses to ISO country codes, handles timeouts via AbortController, skips private/localhost IPs, masks IPs in logs for privacy, and extracts client IPs from X-Forwarded-For headers.

nodes.name: shareTokenService.ts
nodes.summary: JWT-based share token service for generating, verifying, and resolving short-code tokens used for sharing pet data with veterinarians, backed by the vetShareTokens database table.

nodes.name: ShareTokenService
nodes.summary: Generates JWT tokens with nanoid short codes for vet share access, stores them in the vetShareTokens table with expiry, and provides verification, short-code resolution, expiry checking, and safe decoding.

nodes.name: health-summary-rate-limit.service.ts
nodes.summary: Rate limiting service for health summary generation that enforces a 10-per-day rolling window limit for premium users, blocks free tier users, and tracks generation history in the database.

nodes.name: HealthSummaryRateLimitService
nodes.summary: Implements shadow rate limiting with a 24-hour rolling window, checking generation counts against a daily maximum, recording new generations, and providing generation history lookups.

nodes.name: chatCleanupJob.ts
nodes.summary: Cron job that runs daily at 3 AM Bangkok time to delete chat messages older than 3 months, preserving the last 7 days as a safety net, and logs storage statistics after cleanup.

nodes.name: startChatCleanupJob
nodes.summary: Initializes and starts a CronJob that invokes chatCleanupService daily to remove old messages and report storage statistics.

nodes.name: unifiedNotificationJob.ts
nodes.summary: Unified cron job running every minute that handles both admin-scheduled push notifications (with timezone-aware delivery, tier filtering, and optimistic-lock dedup) and user reminder delivery with automatic future occurrence creation for repeating reminders.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses optimistic locking via WHERE on lastSentAt to prevent duplicate sends across concurrent runs. Tracks updated setting IDs in a Set to avoid redundant DB writes within a single minute.

nodes.name: startUnifiedNotificationJob
nodes.summary: Entry point that starts the every-minute cron job orchestrating admin notification and user reminder dispatch.

nodes.name: sendAdminScheduledNotifications
nodes.summary: Queries active notification settings and device tokens, then delivers timezone-aware, consent-filtered, tier-targeted push notifications to eligible users with optimistic-lock deduplication.

nodes.name: sendUserReminders
nodes.summary: Fetches due unsent reminders (up to 100), sends push notifications, batch-updates sentAt for successes, and creates future occurrences for repeating reminders.

nodes.name: createFutureOccurrences
nodes.summary: Creates up to 2 future reminder occurrences for a repeating reminder, preserving pet associations via transactions with conflict-safe inserts.

nodes.name: calculateNextOccurrence
nodes.summary: Computes the next scheduled date for a repeating reminder based on daily, weekly, or monthly interval.

nodes.name: health-insights-prompt-v2.ts
nodes.summary: Production prompt generator for LLM-based personalized pet health insights. Assembles system prompt (PePe veterinarian persona, constraints, output rules) and user prompt (pet profile, breed knowledge, locale) from modular config files, supporting Thai and English output.
nodes.languageNotes: Exports multiple TypeScript interfaces (PetProfile, HealthRisk, BreedKnowledge, PreventiveCareCategory) that define the domain model for health insight generation.

nodes.name: buildHealthInsightsFullPrompt
nodes.summary: Primary entry point that returns both system and user prompts for Gemini health insight generation, combining persona rules with pet-specific context.

nodes.name: buildUserPrompt
nodes.summary: Constructs the user portion of the LLM prompt with pet profile details, serialized breed knowledge, locale-specific formatting rules, and description structure requirements.

nodes.name: health-summary-prompt.ts
nodes.summary: Generates tier-differentiated health summary prompts for the HealthSummary hero section. Free tier prompts create urgency and FOMO to drive conversions, while premium tier prompts provide confident veterinary guidance with activity logging recognition and weight assessment.

nodes.name: getHealthSummaryPrompt
nodes.summary: Builds a complete LLM prompt for pet health summaries, varying tone and strategy based on subscription tier (free: FOMO-driven, premium: confident guidance), with locale-aware pet naming, weight assessment, and activity logging context.

nodes.name: getFakeHealthSummaryText
nodes.summary: Returns a playful locale-specific message for free users who inspect blurred HTML content via dev tools, encouraging premium upgrade.

nodes.name: health-insights-persona.config.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the PePe veterinarian mascot persona configuration including name, gender, experience level, personality traits, tone, and approach used across all health insight LLM prompts.

nodes.name: insight-card-config.ts
nodes.summary: Controls insight card visibility and messaging per subscription tier. Contains breed mortality statistics for FOMO generation, scary vague fact generator, card field visibility configs, free-tier fear-inducing descriptions, a peeker message for HTML inspectors, and premium reassurance messages.

nodes.name: generateScaryVagueFact
nodes.summary: Picks a random breed mortality statistic and formats it as a vague, alarming fact string for free-tier users to encourage premium conversion.

nodes.name: language-output.ts
nodes.summary: Defines locale configuration for Thai and English LLM output including pet name prefixes, species terms, output language labels, locale resolution sources, and pet naming conventions per language.

nodes.name: naming-config.ts
nodes.summary: Provides language-specific pet naming rules (correct/incorrect examples) for Thai and English, plus a formatPetName utility that applies the locale-appropriate prefix.

nodes.name: output-format.ts
nodes.summary: Defines structural requirements for LLM-generated health insights including JSON schema shape, character limits, sentence counts, recommendation bounds, content formatting rules, and target risk level distribution (5 high, 3 medium, 2 low).

nodes.name: personality-config.ts
nodes.summary: Defines PePe's character traits, communication style, and behavioral constraints (no medication dosages, no diagnoses, no surgical/emergency advice) used across all LLM health insight prompts.

nodes.name: subscription-tier-config.ts
nodes.summary: Defines per-tier (free/premium) tone, emphasis, keywords, summary length, detail level, and LLM instruction templates that control how health summaries are generated based on subscription level.

nodes.name: activityMetadataSeeds.ts
nodes.summary: Provides fixed-UUID seed data for pet activity types (Poo, Pee, Feeding) across dog and cat species, serving as the source of truth for consistent IDs across all environments.

nodes.name: symptomSeeds.ts
nodes.summary: Provides fixed-UUID seed data for pet symptom types (Vomiting, Diarrhea, Coughing, Lethargy, Loss of Appetite, Excessive Scratching) across dog and cat species, including a staging-to-production ID migration map.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Main seed orchestrator that provides factory reset (clears all tables respecting FK constraints), database table setup via raw SQL, and selective seeding of users, pets, breeds, pet record lookups, and plan rules with configurable skip options.

nodes.name: factoryReset

tour.title: Server Entry Point
tour.description: Start with src/index.ts, the Fastify server bootstrap that wires the entire application together. It registers 30+ route prefixes (auth, pets, chat, subscriptions, admin, etc.), applies global plugins (CORS, helmet, multipart, rate limiting), runs database migrations via the startup service, and kicks off background cron jobs for notifications and chat cleanup. This single file is your map to every major subsystem in the project.
tour.languageLesson: Fastify uses a plugin-based architecture where each route file exports an async function registered via server.register(plugin, { prefix }). This composable pattern keeps route handlers isolated while sharing the server instance.

tour.title: Database Schema and Connection
tour.description: The data layer is the most depended-upon code in the project, imported by 84 other files. src/db/schema.ts defines 30+ Drizzle ORM tables covering users, pets, subscriptions, health records, chat messages, insights, notifications, and more, along with their enums, indexes, and foreign key relationships. src/db/index.ts creates the singleton Drizzle database instance connected to PostgreSQL. Every service and route ultimately reads or writes through these two files, making them the foundation of the entire system.
tour.languageLesson: Drizzle ORM uses TypeScript's type inference (via typeof and InferSelectModel/InferInsertModel) to derive fully typed query results directly from table definitions, eliminating the need for separate interface declarations.

tour.title: Authentication Middleware
tour.description: With the database in place, the next most critical cross-cutting concern is authentication. src/middleware/auth.ts verifies Supabase JWTs and attaches the authenticated user to Fastify requests, offering three modes: required (authenticateUser), factory (requireAuth), and optional (optionalAuth). src/middleware/adminAuth.ts handles a separate admin auth flow with JWT verification, permission loading, and role-based access guards. Together these two files are imported by 34 route handlers, gating every protected endpoint in the API.
tour.languageLesson: Fastify preHandler hooks let you chain middleware before route execution. The factory pattern (requireAuth) returns a configured hook function, enabling per-route customization of auth requirements.

tour.title: Pet Management and Access Control
tour.description: The core domain of Pawjai is pet management. src/routes/pets.ts handles pet CRUD, profile image uploads via Bunny CDN, and share/helper token generation. It relies on src/middleware/petAccess.ts, which enforces subscription-aware limits -- checking whether a user can access a specific pet or create additional ones based on their plan tier. This middleware delegates to src/services/accessControlService.ts, the single source of truth for subscription state resolution (trial, cancelling, grace periods) with caching and auto-fix for inconsistent data.

tour.title: AI Chat Orchestration
tour.description: The chat feature is one of the most architecturally complex subsystems, with its orchestrator importing 9 internal services. src/services/chat/orchestrator.service.ts coordinates the full message flow: rate limiting, input validation, pet context retrieval, prompt construction, Gemini LLM generation, image upload to CDN, message persistence, and async title generation. src/services/chat/context.service.ts aggregates pet profiles (breed, weight trend, health risks, recent symptoms) into bilingual Thai/English context strings for personalized responses. src/routes/chat.ts validates that the user has pets and an active subscription before delegating to the orchestrator.

tour.title: Health Insights Pipeline
tour.description: Building on the same AI infrastructure as chat, the insights system generates breed-specific health recommendations. src/services/insights/orchestrator.service.ts coordinates a multi-stage pipeline: context resolution, strategy routing (cache/generate/rate-limit), knowledge processing from breed JSON files, LLM prompt building with a veterinarian persona, post-processing, and tier-aware subscription filtering (free users get 3 insights, premium up to 9). src/services/insights/prompt-builder.service.ts constructs the PePe veterinarian persona prompt with pet profile data, pre-categorized risk levels, and recent symptoms.

tour.title: Stripe Billing and Webhooks
tour.description: The subscription system integrates deeply with Stripe for payments. src/services/stripeService.ts is a singleton wrapping 15+ Stripe API methods for checkout sessions, subscription lifecycle (upgrade, cancel, sync), billing portal, payment methods, and invoices. src/services/stripeWebhookService.ts handles inbound webhook events -- checkout completion, subscription updates/deletions, invoice payments, and failed payments -- triggering access control cache invalidation and background health insight regeneration on plan changes. src/services/pricingConfigService.ts manages Stripe price ID resolution through a three-tier strategy: in-memory cache, database lookup, and environment variable fallback.

tour.title: Background Jobs
tour.description: The final piece of the architecture is the cron job system that runs independently of HTTP requests. src/jobs/unifiedNotificationJob.ts runs every minute handling two responsibilities: admin-scheduled push notifications with timezone-aware delivery, tier filtering, and optimistic-lock deduplication, plus user reminder delivery with automatic future occurrence creation for repeating reminders. src/jobs/chatCleanupJob.ts periodically purges stale chat data. Both jobs are started by the entry point during server bootstrap, completing the picture of how Pawjai serves users both synchronously through API routes and asynchronously through background processing.
